issues.legal_issue: The deposit requirement under Section 17 of the Provincial Small Cause Courts Act must be applied practically and does not justify rejecting an application to set aside an ex parte decree where the applicant deposited amounts quantified in the decree and did not wholly disregard the requirement.
A court may extend time for depositing further amounts or require security when the amount payable under an ex parte decree is not specifically quantified.
The rule that Section 17’s deposit requirement is mandatory does not make an application incompetent where the applicant has made a partial deposit, unlike a case of complete non-compliance.
